status: Two source-certified vowels restored after tight native-pixel reinspection and independent root review
scope: Every one of the14 remaining canonical point-note targets in the upper short recension, reinspected in primaryB and actual companion scan. All14 were inspected previously; this pass uses tighter glyph isolation and additional same-page comparisons, not a new witness. Lower long-recension text and commentary are excluded.
method: Fresh pypdf extraction of original embedded rasters, native-pixel crops, and integer nearest-neighbor enlargement only. Tight15× crops reveal one-pixel white gaps obscured perceptually in older wider5× crops. No OCR, sharpening, interpolation, automatic vocalization or grammatical restoration. Resolve only complete printed shapes independently corroborated by root.

inspections.finding: The companion exposes a detached short thick lower bar, but multiple shallow downward projections remain within it. It does not yield a unique complete vowel outline. The primary has a fused lower gimel foot; retain the note.

The initial vav lower bar meets the thin shaft and has an irregular right lower tab. Comparison with same-page plain vav and certified patah identifies a lower-ink issue but does not establish the complete original point; retain the note.
The companion initial vav has a horizontal lower bar joined to its sloping stem. This outline does not securely distinguish a complete original vowel from distorted joined lower ink; retain the note.

Root explicitly withdrew the initial patah approval before edits; retain the note.
